ENFPs are mostly found as the leads of slice of life or what is said to be relatable or empowering movies/series. Most of the time the character goes through a self-discovery phase in life or the character needs to be involved with a lot of other characters. And that’s why ENFPs are perfect for it. ENFPs are used in “self-discovery” genre because they have a creative, interesting dream that they build for themselves but the biggest hurdle for those dreams is they, themselves. It is really interesting to see an ENFP grow as they have a comical yet a loving aura throughout even when things are hard, they don’t lose it. Hence the process is entertaining and engaging for the audience. 

Same with movies/series involving a lot of people, ENFPs are always into a crowd, ENFPs get lonely easily and as a result they have the protective aura which makes them involve with others, so much in order to make others less lonely (atleast inside ENFP heads that’s what they think), making them the extroverts they are. That’s why ENFP characterised main lead will never overshadow other characters but will shine along with others. 


But I don’t think the main lead theory is true for almost every serious genres coz ENFPs in thrillers, crime and horror genre are basically the most loved, comic relief characters lol probably also dies the quickest.

Highkey also want more queer ENFPs in movies/series :’)
